purpose: Add reusable plumbing to evaluate every remaining masked region independently with a scale in [0,1], activated only after the first active-standing policy cycle.
single_framework_change: Introduce a region enum: None, Torso, Neck, LeftProximal, RightProximal.
Introduce a production-compatible action-scaling function covering all eight joint regions.
Make existing compatibility overloads delegate to the scale function without changing their semantics.
Add dev-only command-line selector PhysAnimExperimentalCausalStandingScaledRegion and scale PhysAnimExperimentalCausalStandingScaledScale.
Apply the selected scale only after a previous active-standing policy inference; production scales remain unchanged.
falsification: Any production scale changes without the new selector.
Any legacy compatibility overload changes its retained joint set.
Any selected region affects another region.
Any scale outside [0,1] is not clamped.
next: Screen Neck, LeftProximal, RightProximal and Torso one at a time under -onethread, using full bundles for accepted candidate scales.
